sections.title: Sound of letter gê
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (gê) /ʒe/. Its main sound is heard in (gato) /ˈɡa.tu/, which means cat. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: For the first sound, lift the back of your tongue to touch the roof. Block the air, turn your voice on, and release the air suddenly. For the second sound, push the tongue tip toward the ridge behind your upper teeth. Push air through the narrow gap and let your voice hum. Put a hand on your throat to feel the buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: Before a, o, u or consonants, this letter makes its hard sound as in (grande) /ˈɡɾɐ̃.dɨ/. Before the vowels e or i, this letter makes its soft sound as in (gente) /ˈʒẽ.tɨ/ and (girafa) /ʒiˈɾa.fɐ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not add a burst of air like in game. Before e or i, do not start with a hard stop like the j in jump. Make a smooth sound instead, like the s in measure.
